# Dependencies for the vendored xurdif engine (training, sampling, post-processing,
# and the standalone gradio reference apps).
#
# IMPORTANT: torch/torchvision must match your GPU. Install a CUDA build first, e.g.
#   pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
# They are listed unpinned below so an already-installed CUDA build is left untouched
# (pip treats it as already satisfied and will NOT downgrade it to a CPU wheel).
torch>=2.0
torchvision>=0.15

# --- core training + sampling ---
pytorch-msssim>=1.0      # SSIM loss (xurdif.py)
lpips>=0.1.4             # perceptual loss (xurdiftrainer.py, xurdif.py)
einops>=0.7             # tensor rearrange (xurdif.py)
numpy>=1.24
Pillow>=10.0
tqdm>=4.66

# --- DDIM sampling, CLIP guidance, post-processing (xurdifapp*.py / postproc*.py) ---
diffusers>=0.27         # DDIMScheduler
kornia>=0.7             # enhance/filters used by postproc
opencv-python>=4.8      # cv2 post-processing
ftfy                    # CLIP tokenizer dependency
regex                   # CLIP tokenizer dependency
git+https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git   # `import clip` (OpenAI CLIP)

# --- standalone gradio apps only (xurdifapp.py / xurdifapp3.py); Kiln does not need these ---
gradio>=4.0
